definitions.explanation: Eggs that are stirred while cooking in a pan, resulting in small, dry, crumbly pieces. Differs from Western scrambled eggs in that the result is drier and more finely broken up.

notes:
Japanese-style scrambled eggs made by stirring eggs continuously in a pan (often with chopsticks) until they form small, dry, fluffy crumbles. Unlike Western scrambled eggs, which are typically soft and creamy, {炒|い}り{卵|たまご} is cooked until fully set and crumbly. It is a staple in bento boxes and Japanese home cooking.

- {炒|い}り{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make scrambled eggs

- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧{炒|い}り{卵|たまご}: sweet scrambled eggs (seasoned with sugar)
